title.narrative: Investing to achieve impact against tuberculosis and HIV. - Cabo Verde (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Cabo Verde, TB/HIV, Coordination Committee of the Fight against AIDS of Cabo Verde (CCS-SIDA)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections by 15 percent by 2017. Reduce TB-related mortality by 35 percent by 2019. The objectives of this program are: Detect 1,515 cases of TB, all forms (TBAF). Improve cooperation between community organizations, CSOs and public and private health care providers.. Improve institutional capacity by guaranteeing the necessary resources for plan implementation. Improve intra- and inter-sectoral coordination. Improve knowledge of the dynamic and determinants of the HIV epidemic within the general population, including vulnerable groups. Increase the treatment success rate to 90 percent. Promote and increase access to HIV and STI diagnosis within the general population and vulnerable groups. Provide an ethical and legal environment appropriate to AIDS control. Reduce deaths due to HIV/TB co-infection by 50 percent. Reduce mortality and morbidity by ensuring access to treatment and to medical and psychosocial care. Reduce the risk of HIV infection and reverse the epidemic’s trend among the general population and vulnerable groups. Strengthen the NACP’s management capacities. Strengthen the socio-economic support for people affected and infected by HIV, particularly at-risk populations
